issue: Original E12 source report P_delta_cb_rdirect_LOS_over_i_mu_Mpc3 used unfiltered direct theta(K)/sigma_LOS,R16. But E11/E12 model rank r is the R16-top-hat FILTERED local LOS relative wind. The correct physical cross with that r must multiply the long-mode numerator by the same W_R16(K). E12 sigma_R16 already included W_R16(K)^2 and remains correct. This is a field-definition consistency correction, not a new fitted amplitude.
exact_correction: P_delta_cb_rDIRECT_R16_filtered_over_i_mu(K) = W(K * 16 Mpc/h) * E12.original_P_delta_cb_rdirect_LOS_over_i_mu_Mpc3(K). The E12 original table is explicitly the RAW unfiltered-theta cross divided by filtered RMS and must NOT be represented as a filtered-rank cross.
reason_not_optional: Since Gamma in E11 is response to filtered one-sigma rank, Wick/Gaussian P_(D,r) needs the same filtered field. Leaving out W is conceptually inconsistent even where W~1 on the four fixed long modes.
methodology: Derived algebraically after inspecting already completed E12 source-only outputs, never called a prospectively accepted E12 test. Subsequent E13 fully regenerates its normalized Gamma with direct vTk-filtered sigma and multiplies ONLY with corrected P_delta_cb_rDIRECT_R16_filtered. No new experimental cut, sign, mock, seeds or data.
